per_article_summaries: Former Ferrari team principal Jean Todt has rejected the idea that Michael Schumacher's confidence bordered on arrogance during his Formula 1 career. Todt opened up on his time working with Schumacher from 1996 to 2006. The former Ferrari chief added that as his relationship with the German driver progressed to a "friend and family relationship", he quickly saw behind the mask.

Arvid Lindblad made his F1 debut for Racing Bulls in Melbourne. The 18-year-old was fast-tracked through the ranks by former driver adviser Helmut Marko. Lindblad has impressed with his work rate and the manner with which he got up to speed with regulations.

Red Bull has struggled in the first three races of the new Formula 1 season. The team is 0.97 seconds off the pace in qualifying and as much as 1.26 seconds per lap behind Mercedes in race trim. The RB22 is the slowest Red Bull car in 11 years. The team is currently sixth in the constructors’ championship.

Every Formula 1 driver races with a fixed number. The series introduced the concept of permanent numbers in 2014. Until 2025, drivers were required to use the same race number throughout their careers. Drivers can now submit a request and, if it is approved, they are allowed to change their number.

All Ferrari-powered teams combined have gained 25 positions on the opening lap. No other engine manufacturer matches that figure, although the comparison is skewed by the fact that Audi and Honda each supply only a single team. Red Bull and Audi have struggled significantly: Red Bull-powered cars have lost 21 positions on the opening lap so far, while Audi sits at minus 26.

Mercedes Formula 1 CEO Toto Wolff reveals he was ready to fire both Lewis Hamilton and Nico Rosberg during their heated team-mate rivalry in 2016. The 2016 season featured an intense intra-team battle between the two Mercedes drivers. Their fierce rivalry reached a head as they fought for the championship title.
